article-14c-applies-to-every-suspension._: The reason `basis` is a column at all. Without the check, art. 14/c — written for a VOLUNTARY withdrawal — fires on a CBJ penalty, and a brokerage serving a long sanction is reported CANCELLED. Must kill 'DOES NOT fire on an art. 21/b SANCTION'.

two-years-as-730-days._: Day arithmetic instead of calendar arithmetic. Wrong by one day across a leap year, in the direction that deems a licence cancelled a day early. Must kill the leap-day test.

exactly-two-years-already-exceeded._: `>` becomes `>=`. The article says «تجاوزت» — exceeded. Must kill the boundary test and nothing else.

acts-never-answered-by-a-later-term._: Drop the term-issue filter. A cancelled-then-re-licensed office is then reported CANCELLED for the rest of its life. Must kill 'an act is answered by a term issued AFTER it'.

sanction-period-never-runs-out._: A sanction whose stated period has passed keeps suspending forever. Must kill 'stops suspending the moment the period passes'.

manual-marker-read-as-an-expiry._: Remove the manual-lapse branch, so `status: 'lapsed'` falls through to the term arithmetic. Must kill the marker test — and the failure is the point: it reports a licence that never ran out as having run out.
